profile_text.body:
Zscaler is a publicly traded cloud security company, founded in 2007 and headquartered in San Jose, California, that trades on Nasdaq under the ticker ZS. The company describes itself as a leading cloud enterprise security provider helping global businesses adopt zero trust for secure digital transformation, and it markets its Zero Trust Exchange as a platform for securing and simplifying business operations at scale. Its site emphasizes a unified, zero-trust framework for tracing data lineage and governing agent-to-agent interactions, alongside an ecosystem of partners and integrations intended to support cloud deployments.

The company's tracked AI product, Zscaler AI, sits within the Security and Identity AI category and encompasses cloud security AI, a security service edge platform, data loss prevention, and AI traffic inspection. Zscaler holds SEC registrant status under CIK 0001713683, confirming its standing as a for-profit public company. The site's held facts note 174 California law exposure entries, indicating meaningful legal activity in that jurisdiction, though no specific cases are detailed in the available data.
